dashboard.label: Setup Status
dashboard.description: Post-deployment verification - confirms the startup script pre-loaded indexes, roles, and users for this lab session.

search.query: | rest /services/authorization/roles | search title IN (role_loc2, role_loc3, role_global) | stats count
| rest /services/authentication/users | search title IN (user_loc2, user_loc3, user_global) | stats count
| rest /services/apps/local | search title=dcloud_lab disabled=0 | stats count

| rest /services/data/indexes | search title=loc* | stats count as Found | eval Check="Indexes (loc*)", Expected=6 | append [| rest /services/authorization/roles | search title IN (role_loc2, role_loc3, role_global) | stats count as Found | eval Check="Roles (role_loc2/3/global)", Expected=3] | append [| rest /services/authentication/users | search title IN (user_loc2, user_loc3, user_global) | stats count as Found | eval Check="Users (user_loc2/3/global)", Expected=3] | append [| rest /services/apps/local | search title=dcloud_lab disabled=0 | stats count as Found | eval Check="App enabled (dcloud_lab)", Expected=1] | eval Status=if(Found>=Expected, "✓ OK", "✗ CHECK") | table Check Expected Found Status

| rest /services/authorization/roles | search title IN (role_loc2, role_loc3, role_global) | eval indexes_allowed=mvjoin(srchIndexesAllowed, ", ") | eval inherits=mvjoin(imported_roles, ", ") | rename title as Role | table Role indexes_allowed inherits

| rest /services/authentication/users | search title IN (user_loc2, user_loc3, user_global) | eval assigned_roles=mvjoin(roles, ", ") | rename title as User, realname as "Full name" | table User "Full name" assigned_roles
| rest /services/data/indexes | search title=loc* | rename title as Index, currentDBSizeMB as "Size (MB)", totalEventCount as Events | table Index "Size (MB)" Events | sort Index
